description:
# [1.25.1](https://github.com/atanuroy22/morphe-patches/compare/v1.25.0...v1.25.1) (2026-05-05)

## Premium YouTube Fork Customization

This release includes pre-configured defaults for Premium YouTube branding:

### Build

* **Fork customization:** Set preferred YouTube and YouTube Music defaults for Premium branding
  - YouTube: Set MORPHE_YOUTUBE_PACKAGE_NAME to `com.google.android.apps.youtube.kids`
  - YouTube Music: Set MORPHE_MUSIC_PACKAGE_NAME to `app.revanced.android.apps.youtube.music`
  - Video quality, playback speed, swipe controls, shorts, and seekbar features enabled by default
  - Disabled environment check warnings in CheckEnvironmentPatch
  - Fixed release workflow for fork without GitHub Packages access

### YouTube Defaults Enabled

- Remember video quality changes
- Remember playback speed changes
- Advanced video quality menu
- Remember shorts quality changes
- Slide to seek & tap to seek
- Swipe to change videos with brightness & volume gestures
- Auto-brightness gesture support
- Hide shorts on home feed
- Hide YouTube Doodles
- Hide endscreen cards and suggested videos

### YouTube Music Defaults

- Package name: app.revanced.android.apps.youtube.music
- Custom branding: YT Music Premium
- Default icon style: Original

### Notes

This fork release is optimized for users who want pre-configured Premium YouTube branding with sensible defaults. All features can still be customized through the in-app settings.
